gloss: to be patient; to endure; to persevere

definitions.gloss: to be patient; to endure; to persevere
definitions.explanation: To bear a difficult or unpleasant situation with patience, without complaining or giving up. Implies active endurance over a period of time.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{辛抱|しんぼう}→辛抱：05101_shinbou⟧して⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be patient a little longer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{辛抱|しんぼう}→辛抱：05101_shinbou⟧すれば、⟦きっと→きっと：00860_kitto⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you persevere, good things will surely come.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}くて→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{辛抱|しんぼう}→辛抱：05101_shinbou⟧しよう⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: Even though the salary is low, I decided to endure it for three years to gain experience.

notes:
Emphasizes patient endurance of hardship or discomfort. Often used when encouraging someone to hang in there through a tough situation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{辛抱|しんぼう}{強|づよ}い→辛抱強い：18963_shinbouzuyoi⟧ — patient, persevering
- ⟦{辛抱|しんぼう}→辛抱：05101_shinbou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ — lacking patience
- ⟦{辛抱|しんぼう}→辛抱：05101_shinbou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{限界|げんかい}→限界：02715_genkai⟧ — the limit of one's patience
- ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{辛抱|しんぼう}→辛抱：05101_shinbou⟧ — just a little more patience

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{我慢|がまん}する→我慢する：25343_gamansuru⟧ — to endure, tolerate; more about suppressing feelings or desires in the moment
- ⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧ — to withstand, bear; focuses on physical or emotional resistance to something
- ⟦{忍耐|にんたい}→忍耐：05212_nintai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to be patient; more formal and literary than {辛抱|しんぼう}する
